run_tesseract_ocr: run tesseract CLI OCR on document pages and return extracted text cells with bounding boxes
create_ocr_cli_model: create a TesseractOcrCliModel instance with enabled flag, artifacts path, and TesseractCliOcrOptions
test_tesseract_version: test tesseract CLI availability by retrieving its name and version string
run_orientation_detection: run tesseract OSD mode to detect document orientation and script language
review_ocr_pipeline: review the TesseractOcrCliModel __call__ method that processes page batches with OCR rectangles and post-processing
